Welcome to my website!

I am a second-year Computer Science PhD student at NYU Courant advised by Benedikt Bünz and Joseph Bonneau. The focus of my research is on cryptography, mostly proof systems and accumulation.

Before graduating my PhD, I did a B.A./M.S. dual degree program in CS at Boston University, where I was lucky to learn cryptography from Leo Reyzin and worked as a TA for Ran Canetti’s cryptography course.
